title: Dietavity Sales Engine v2 contracts
description: Boundary contracts proposed by Ticket 57. This schema does not authorize actions or define a database schema.

source.description: Explicit provenance. Generated material is deliberately not a fact, policy, reviewed-knowledge, or system source.

conversationArtifact.description: Prospective non-authoritative conversational metadata; its message text is transformable data, never a truth or delivery source.

conversationArtifactContext.description: Bounded conversational material projected only from Ticket 17A metadata and its canonical outbound logical reply. It is not product truth, policy, safety, authorization, delivery, execution, or factual correctness.

lineage_artifact_ids.description: Every ID must reference a sibling retained conversation_artifacts item; executable validation enforces this cross-item membership.

conversationalTask.description: Bounded conversational-generation selection only; referenced artifact text is not truth, policy, safety, authorization, delivery, or execution evidence. Cross-context artifact membership is enforced by executable validation.

oneOf.title: completed assessment with no findings clears
completed assessment with a blocking finding blocks
completed assessment with review-only findings is indeterminate
unavailable assessment is empty and indeterminate

artifactReproductionSafetyGate.description: A clearance permits only the bound conversational operation; it never establishes artifact truth, policy, safety approval, authorization, execution, or delivery.

ActionResult.description: Bounded evidence of one attempted authorized-action execution. It is not authorization or delivery evidence and never carries executor internals.

CommercialExecutionExpression.description: Closed customer-expressible semantics for a commercial execution state. It references, but does not copy, a successful bounded destination by action_id.

PreComposerEnvelope.description: Immutable bounded execution-result envelope for a future Composer. It deliberately excludes AuthorizedAction internals, execution keys, raw executor output, and raw workflow state.

WithholdingExpression.description: Ticket 65E.1 closed communication semantics for withholding. It establishes only a current-response boundary; it does not explain cause or future/permanent capability. Exact directive/claim combinations are schema-enforced.

ComposerResult.description: Ticket 66 candidate customer language. Runtime validation additionally compares coverage and destination evidence against the excluded FinalComposerInput. Natural-language semantic entailment is a Ticket 67 responsibility.

ComposerFailure.description: Ticket 66 bounded adapter/model availability failure. It contains no customer text or raw error detail.

FinalCustomerResponseGate.description: Ticket 67 assesses the exact Ticket 66 candidate against FinalComposerInput. Clearance creates no product, medical, execution, delivery, or action authority.

ConversationalArtifactOutputIntent.description: Ticket 65B.1 prospective, application-side persistence identity. It contains no customer text and establishes neither persistence nor delivery.

FinalComposerInput.description: Ticket 65E's final bounded semantic envelope for Ticket 66. Cross-stage gate, action-result, and policy-mapping alignment is enforced by the executable builder/validator.

TurnResult.description: Ticket 68 operational result. response_eligible means eligible for downstream delivery, not delivered.

conversational_generation.description: Bounded, non-authoritative customer-expressible material. Exact required_coverage alignment and selected-artifact membership are enforced by the executable ResponsePlan validator and builder.

commercial_semantics.description: Closed customer-expressible commercial intent. It establishes neither action execution nor destination delivery; exact commercial-coverage alignment is executable-validator enforced.
